description: Execute arbitrary JavaScript in a live browser session and return the result. Runs in the session's current page, so DOM mutations, globals and storage persist across calls — unlike the stateless eval tool, which loads its own throwaway page each call. Script-driven navigation moves the session's URL. JS exceptions are reported with name, line/column and stack.

timeout_ms.description:
Await budget for the script's promise in ms (default 5000, clamped
100..120000). Pass a larger budget for slow page-side work such as
uploads through the page's own fetch; on expiry the tool errors with
EVAL_TIMEOUT (the script may still be running) instead of returning
a null result.

name: session_eval
